proposed_from.topic: Rank normalization and target-loading weak-identification boundaries for honest Synthetic Survival Control bands. In the right-censored survival-factor panel, make the canonical coordinate construction conditional on the model's target-pre factor compatibility and use the positive pre-period Gram for uniqueness; define W_r^* as the minimax expected supremum width among uniformly honest continuous-time bands for the missing post-control survival curve. Prove the sharp exact-rank-one frontier W_1^* asymptotic to (N0 KD)^(-1/2). For every fixed r>=2 on the quantitatively strong exact-rank class, prove the unrestricted bracket c rho_r <= W_r^* <= C{rho_r+eta_D(K_D)}, with W_r^* asymptotic to rho_r only on subregimes where eta_D(K_D)=O(rho_r), and do not assert unrestricted tightness. Prove the flagship same-topic boundary that, without a uniform positive pre-period contrast-Gram lower bound, minimax honest width is Theta(1) even on a donor-visible known-rank-two subclass of the Han--Shah Theorem 1 factor-and-span model; hence donor-rank detection alone cannot license shrinking or rank-adaptive bands. Construct and rigorously validate the censoring-aware patient-level functional-PCR martingale-multiplier band for the stated upper envelope, with controlled interpolation and normalization-preserving Le Cam lower pairs. The remaining repair must derive the target coordinate from factor compatibility and positive-Gram uniqueness, prove the pooled non-identically-censored rank-one Kaplan--Meier expansion and multiplier coupling, establish a genuinely grid-uniform conditional multiplier and random-quantile theorem for the data-dependent functional-PCR derivative including covariance estimation, entropy and fallback events, correct the Pinsker locator to Lemma 2.5(i), and substantively position or remove every retained comparator. Do not claim unrestricted higher-rank W_r^* asymptotic to rho_r unless an explicit measurable estimator is proved to remove eta_D uniformly for every relative-growth sequence; a matching eta_D converse would instead sharpen the upper envelope, not imply the rho_r frontier. Do not strengthen the model, retreat to pointwise or balanced-only asymptotics, or offer bootstrap validity without the minimax converses.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest direct result is HanShah2025SSC, which identifies the same post-control survival curve and proves finite-grid consistency for Kaplan--Meier PCR but supplies neither continuous-time uniform honesty nor a minimax lower bound. The closest inferential analogue is CattaneoFengTitiunik2021, whose scalar prediction interval has pre-fit and post-prediction components but no survival normalization or rank-specific degeneracy. The proposed kernel is the new theorem that canonical normalization removes all heterogeneous loading coordinates exactly at total rank one, forcing \(W_1^*\asymp(N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\), while a normalization-preserving target-loading subexperiment restores the additional \(K_T^{-1/2}\) term at every fixed rank at least two. The patient-martingale functional-PCR upper bound and the two matching Le Cam channels make this a sharp frontier rather than a bootstrap-validity add-on.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine the sharp rank-normalization phase transition for uniformly honest continuous-time Synthetic Survival Control bands.
seed_details.summary: Prove the donor-only exact-rank-one width and the target-pre-plus-donor width for every fixed higher rank, with an attaining patient-multiplier functional-PCR band and matching normalization-preserving Le Cam pairs.
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction and Conclusion, Theorem 1 and its substitution proof, Theorem 2, the three-term error decomposition in Appendix Section 9.6, the row-space lemma, the PCR stability lemma, and the PETAL donor-bootstrap paragraph were read from the arXiv source.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Differentiate the minimum-norm PCR prediction map after separating the common normalization direction; the target-pre derivative is zero when \(d=r-1=0\) and nonzero on a rank-at-least-two contrast submodel.
seed_details.destination_search: Exact searches pairing Synthetic Survival Control with confidence band, minimax, rank normalization, functional PCR, and censoring found no occupied target; adjacent results stop at finite-grid consistency, scalar prediction intervals, or one-sample survival bands.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from HanShah2025SSC and CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 because one merely adds their two error terms and applies a survival bootstrap.
seed_details.rebuttal: Neither paper derives the normalized PCR derivative, the exact rank-one disappearance, a continuous-time patient-martingale coupling, arbitrary-relative-growth uniformity, or normalization-preserving lower pairs.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize honest adaptation from exact rank two to exact rank one under survival normalization.
seed_details.summary: Derive the second-singular-value testing boundary for an honest band that attains the donor-only width at rank one and the two-channel width on separated rank-two laws.
seed_details.anchor_read: The SSC rank-selection discussion and Theorem 2 were read together with CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 Sections 2, 3, 5, and 6, especially Theorems 2.1, 2.2, 5.1, and 6.1 and the Conclusions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace fixed-rank PCR projection by a normalization-preserving composite test for a second contrast singular value before calibrating the oracle band.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for honest adaptive survival-factor bands and unknown-rank synthetic survival inference found matrix-norm confidence sets and rank-selection heuristics, but no censored causal-curve separation frontier.
seed_details.red_team: CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 already solves honest rank adaptation for matrix completion.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their loss is Frobenius norm and their testing experiment lacks survival normalization, censoring martingales, a missing post-control curve, and the discontinuous target-pre width channel.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Develop sharp bias-aware bands under quantitatively approximate survival-factor rank.
seed_details.summary: Add a sharp projection-residual modulus to the target-pre and donor-patient rates and match it by varying the singular-value tail and post-span defect.
seed_details.anchor_read: SSC Lemma 1 and its Taylor motivation, the exact row-space proof, and the Conclusion were read with CurthPoonNoriGonzalez2024's survival-curve bias constructions, AtheyBayatiDoudchenkoImbensKhosravi2021's nuclear-norm oracle bounds and approximate-rank discussion, and AgarwalShahShen2025PCR's Conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact post row-space inclusion by an oracle inequality for the functional projection residual before applying multiplier calibration.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for approximate low-rank synthetic survival confidence bands found matrix prediction bounds and one-sample survival bands, but no honest causal-curve width separating approximation bias from both patient-noise channels.
seed_details.red_team: The result is immediate by adding a deterministic tail bound to AtheyBayatiDoudchenkoImbensKhosravi2021.
seed_details.rebuttal: A prediction-norm tail bound is not an honest sup-norm bias modulus for a missing survival curve, and its estimability and matching censored lower bound are unresolved.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Derive the semiparametric efficiency bound for the fixed-rank censored Synthetic Survival Control curve.
seed_details.summary: Project the target-curve derivative onto the observed counting-process tangent space and determine the exact efficiency covariance in each rank regime.
seed_details.anchor_read: The SSC identification and consistency proofs were read; they bound errors but never derive a tangent space, canonical gradient, or efficiency constant.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace perturbation inequalities by a pathwise derivative of the normalized low-rank survival map and an observed-data tangent-space projection.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found efficiency theory for ordinary censored survival effects but no factor-panel missing-curve efficiency bound.
seed_details.red_team: The efficient influence function is just the Kaplan--Meier influence function multiplied by oracle synthetic-control weights.
seed_details.rebuttal: Estimated factor spaces and target loadings alter the tangent projection, and the rank-one derivative degeneracy changes the nuisance tangent component.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Establish a two-speed functional limit law for censoring-aware SSC under unrestricted relative growth.
seed_details.summary: Derive the sum of independent target-pre and donor Gaussian martingale processes and its rank-one degeneration, with a uniformly valid patient multiplier law.
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Section 3 multiplier constructions, the main bootstrap theorem, confidence-band construction, Discussion, and martingale proof using predictable variation and Rebolledo's theorem were read.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Stack patient martingales across cells and apply the derivative of an estimated functional-PCR map before the martingale central limit step.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found survival-process bands and functional principal-component bands separately, but not their composition for a synthetic counterfactual curve.
seed_details.red_team: DoblerPaulyScheike2019's functional delta method already covers any smooth plug-in map.
seed_details.rebuttal: The PCR map has an estimated singular subspace and a rank-dependent derivative, and uniform validity over arbitrary two-rate sequences is not a direct fixed-model delta-method corollary.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize exactly when the PETAL donor bootstrap can ignore target-pre patient uncertainty.
seed_details.summary: Derive the observable rate frontier on which donor-only and patient-level multiplier bands are asymptotically equivalent, and prove undercoverage beyond it.
seed_details.anchor_read: The PETAL paragraph reporting 500 donor resamples and the estimator's three-term error decomposition were read; the paper provides no bootstrap theorem.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Condition on the target-pre cohort in the donor bootstrap and compare the omitted target-loading influence variance with the donor influence variance.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing the named SSC method with donor bootstrap validity or simultaneous coverage returned no theorem.
seed_details.red_team: The validity region follows immediately by comparing \(K_T^{-1/2}\) and \((N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\).
seed_details.rebuttal: A valid equivalence frontier also requires conditional Gaussian comparison, anti-concentration, estimated PCR covariance, and a normalization-preserving undercoverage sequence.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine whether estimated censoring weights add a first-order width channel in each normalized rank regime.
seed_details.summary: Construct an orthogonal IPCW functional-PCR estimator and derive its efficiency loss under covariate-dependent censoring.
seed_details.anchor_read: SSC's censoring assumption, its IPCW footnote, and its Conclusion were read with RobinsFinkelstein2000's weighted risk-set identification argument and DoblerPaulyScheike2019's joint multiplier logic.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace each Kaplan--Meier martingale by an IPCW influence function plus the censoring-score correction before differentiating PCR.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found IPCW survival inference and recent survival efficiency results, but no latent-factor synthetic counterfactual curve with a rank-specific nuisance-efficiency calculation.
seed_details.red_team: Cross-fitting makes censoring-nuisance estimation second order, so no new width question remains.
seed_details.rebuttal: Orthogonality must first be derived for the composed low-rank curve map, and the efficiency projection can retain censoring-score information even when nuisance remainders are second order.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize when smoothing, truncation, and interpolation inflation may be omitted from an SSC multiplier band.
seed_details.summary: Prove an if-and-only-if shifted-process criterion for uninflated band coverage and a normalization-preserving undercoverage witness when it fails.
seed_details.anchor_read: The prior proposal's honest-scope and technical-limitation sections were read together with its separate bias and stochastic constructions; the necessity of an uninflated band is explicitly left open.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compare the deterministic reconstruction shift with the anti-concentration scale of the two-channel Gaussian supremum before transferring multiplier quantiles.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found generic high-dimensional shifted-Gaussian and honest-bias methods, but no SSC-specific normalization-preserving necessity result.
seed_details.red_team: This is only the standard requirement that bias be smaller than standard error.
seed_details.rebuttal: The contribution is the uniform if-and-only-if aggregate criterion after PCR, censoring, and grid interpolation, plus a model-valid local undercoverage sequence.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Can block or placebo symmetry yield a finite-sample SSC counterfactual-curve band under censoring?
seed_details.summary: Invert censoring-weighted functional conformity scores over donor-label or time-block orbits and quantify coverage error under approximate exchangeability.
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the conditional prediction-interval decomposition, the comparison with conformal inference, and the Conclusion were read; cross-sectional permutation is reported to have poor coverage in their framework.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Specify a symmetry orbit that respects whole patient cohorts and censoring, then prove that the normalized factor residual score is exchangeable under the null.
seed_details.destination_search: ChernozhukovWuthrichZhu2021 covers scalar synthetic-control counterfactuals under symmetry, but searches found no right-censored continuous-curve analogue.
seed_details.red_team: Latent confounding and heterogeneous censoring destroy the exchangeability required for exact conformal validity.
seed_details.rebuttal: A narrow block-exchangeable subclass is defensible and an explicit approximation-error theorem is possible, but the extra symmetry makes this less valuable than the full exact-factor minimax class.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The M17 lane is not selected because parallel factor structure alone does not supply the necessary symmetry.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Learn a treatment-adoption timing rule from synthetic counterfactual survival trajectories.
seed_details.summary: Choose a budget-constrained unit-level adoption policy to maximize restricted mean survival and derive regret under censored low-rank outcome learning.
seed_details.anchor_read: The application-led Introduction and Conclusion were read; they motivate when-if decisions but identify only a fixed target unit's counterfactual trajectory.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Expand the identifying model from one missing control curve to policy-indexed potential survival curves before defining an orthogonal welfare score.
seed_details.destination_search: Policy-learning searches found censored treatment-rule methods, but not policy regret built from Synthetic Survival Control factor panels.
seed_details.red_team: The published SSC model does not identify welfare for new adoption policies, so regret cannot be studied without a new causal model.
seed_details.rebuttal: A policy-indexed extension could be valid, but the necessary identification expansion moves beyond the direct D-1.1 gap and sharply lowers feasibility.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The M16 lane is not selected because the anchor identifies a fixed missing curve rather than values for a policy class.
